title: Parviz Jafari's 1976 Tehran UFO encounter
summary: James Fox tells of Parviz Jafari's 1976 Tehran UFO encounter, about 1976 at Tehran, Iran, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Iranian pilot fires at a UAP and goes down

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker, says he met Parviz Jafari, an Iranian pilot who, he says, had a dramatic UFO encounter over Tehran in the mid-1970s while flying an F-4 Phantom fighter jet. Fox points to an assessment of the incident by the DIA, the US Defense Intelligence Agency, as backing for the account. If true, it is a military jet meeting an unknown object, with US intelligence taking note.
